field_errors.correct_value: room temperature (approx. 25 C, not stated numerically)
field_errors.evidence: later experimentally synthesized with the room temperature conductivity up to 0.11 mS cm-1.25

verdicts.explanation: The 0.11 mS/cm value is correctly identified as an experimental value from prior work (cited ref. 24/25), so data_origin literature_cited is right. However, the paper explicitly ties the 0.11 mS/cm value to room temperature, so the null measurement temperature is wrong, and under the strict rule the record fails.

The 0.212 mS/cm DFT value for LiGa(SeO3)2 is explicitly attributed to ref. 24 in the sentence containing the quote, so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature for this value, so null is correct, and all secondary fields are null as the paper does not state them.
